description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sitinamaluwa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830116
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, and encumbrances) in Sitinamaluwa village. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, property rights, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
